AlternateTargets: Deshan goes down with his bowl
Senses.Explanation: A case title, literally 'Deshan carries his bowl.' It occurs 115 times in 41 allowlisted texts. The case records Deshan going down with his bowl before bell or drum; Xuefeng asks where he is going, Deshan returns to his quarters, Xuefeng reports this to Yantou, and Yantou says Deshan has not understood the last phrase. Deshan summons Yantou, who privately states his meaning; the next day's ascent of the seat differs from usual, and Yantou says Deshan will live only three more years. The corpus turns this named encounter into a case heading, verse topic, question asked at the teaching seat, assigned object of inquiry, and point of later prose comment. Recorded replies to 'what is its meaning?' include 'no meaning' followed by 'if he wanted to go, he went; if he wanted to sit, he sat,' and, elsewhere, 'buying dear and selling cheap.'
Senses.Note: The Zen deviation is institutional: an ordinary meal-bowl movement becomes the fixed public name of a multi-speaker case, repeatedly raised, questioned, versified, and assigned for inquiry. The corpus's divergent later comments are reported as comments, not combined into an interpretation of Deshan's intent. The title and descriptions name the same encounter and require one sense.

Occurrences.Kwic: 德山托鉢德山一日托鉢下堂。見雪峯問者。老漢鐘未鳴鼓未響。托鉢向甚處去。山便回方丈。峯舉似巖頭。頭云。大小德山未會末後句。山聞。令侍者喚巖頭來。問曰。汝不肯老僧那。巖頭密啟其意。山乃休去。明日陞座。果與尋常不同。
